subject: [RFC PATCH v2 18/18] mm/filemap: add a debugfs switch for lockless page cache reads

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch adds a debugfs switch to control lockless page cache reads in the Linux kernel. The goal is to provide a way to turn off lockless reads, which can be problematic for certain workloads or when there's a bug in the read path. The switch is added as a static key that can be enabled or disabled through debugfs. When enabled, it stops filemap_read() and shmem_file_read_iter() from setting PG_rcu_free and copying without a reference. This allows users to test and verify the correctness of lockless reads before they are enabled by default.
